fields.stockWeaponPortraits: 81 complete standard-weapon portraits from ABIBuilder plus the complete RM44 inventory icon from ABI Tracker. The DBR, AX50, and AR-30 still use missing-art placeholders rather than bare receiver pictures.
fields.supplementalAmmunition: The AX50 M2 round is restored from the cached bullet detail and localization records. Its tier is 6; price and weight are unavailable. It uses a missing-art placeholder.
fields.wearableCompatibility: 39 helmet profiles and 33 shield pairings from ABIDB-WEB. Audio uses headset and built-in audio fields. Gas-mask fit is inferred from coverage and requires an in-game check.
fields.mapArtwork: Valley and Northridge use cached Fandom reference map artwork. Provenance is in map-art-sources.json; these are not current routing maps.
